ios.desc:
Welcome to Quotable, where inspiration meets creativity.

Looking for a way to keep your motivation high or share meaningful messages with the world? Quotable is your personal quotes and text art app, designed to inspire you daily and bring your thoughts to life. With Quotable, you can find and save your favorite quotes, create beautiful text art, and set them as widgets, wallpapers, or share them across social media.

Stay Inspired Every Day

Positive reminders are one of the simplest and most effective tools for mental well-being and growth. By surrounding yourself with meaningful words and daily motivation, you can keep the right thoughts in focus, especially on those challenging days when you need them most. With Quotable, you'll have the power to create and display these reminders in a way that’s personal, beautiful, and ever-present.

Create, Customize, and Share

Quotable lets you do more than just read quotes—you can turn them into stunning pieces of visual art. Whether you're making a custom widget for your home screen, creating an inspiring wallpaper, or designing social media content, Quotable has you covered. Tap into your creative side with our powerful editing tools that include:

Quote Library
Explore a huge library of inspirational, motivational, and thought-provoking quotes. Save your favorites for easy access.

Text Art Editor
Customize your designs with fonts, text sizes, frames, effects, and more. Add image backgrounds from your gallery or select from integrated stock photos.

Templates & Effects
Get started quickly with our beautifully designed templates and apply effects to make your designs stand out.

Custom Widgets
Set your favorite quotes as iPhone home screen widgets for daily inspiration.

Wallpapers
Create visually stunning wallpapers to keep you inspired throughout the day.

Quote of the Day Notifications
Receive a daily quote to keep your motivation on track. Customize when and how you receive notifications.

Social Sharing
Share your creations directly to Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and more.

Why Choose Quotable?

While other apps focus on either delivering quotes or offering a text editor, Quotable brings the best of both worlds together. It's perfect for those looking for daily inspiration and a creative outlet to express their thoughts. From creating motivational graphics to personalizing your iPhone with inspiring widgets, Quotable helps you stay motivated and creative every day.

Ready to Get Started?

Download Quota

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an iOS app that puts motivating quotes in your widgets

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I love a good daily quote for motivation and inspiration so I made this app to submit to a hackathon.

It has a quote library with thousands of quotes that you can browse and save, then turn into pretty word art using a fun little editor. Once you have a cool design you can set them as iOS widgets, export as wallpapers, social posts etc.

It also has a quote of the day feature that will send a curated quote as a notification on a schedule of your choosing.

All SwiftUI, Firebase, usual indie iOS stack.

It's fun to use and can feed you a daily dose of motivation when you need it.

Launching on Product Hunt today too if you want to support:
https://www.producthunt.com/posts/quotable-3

Thanks all,
Jack
